finding: The study suggests that while SARS-CoV-2 can be detected in the placenta or vaginal secretions of pregnant women with COVID-19, detection in these samples may not be directly associated with neonatal infection, and mode of delivery may not significantly impact vertical transmission.
mod_finding: The study found that detection of SARS-CoV-2 in placental or vaginal secretions was not necessarily associated with neonatal infection, and both vaginal and cesarean delivery were associated with cases of vertical transmission.
